denominator_note: 389 frozen gate rows (4 duplicated IDs across minimal-pairs / minimal-pairs-supplement: MP-014A/B, MP-015A/B; 385 unique case IDs). Rates computed on rows.

review_finals_taxonomy.note: All 30 review finals now dual-annotated (9 from Tier-1 stage + 21 this task). SHOULD_ALREADY cases are registered Tier-1 bug candidates (spec 25), not Tier-2 headroom.

theoretical_headroom.definition: All POTENTIALLY_ELIMINABLE review finals solved perfectly by classified Tier-2 operators.

realistic_headroom.definition: Only operators with clear premises, low risk, high annotation agreement, and evidence present.
qualifying_cases: CAL015 (RULE_PLUS_CONDITION: near-verbatim span, LOW risk, both passes agree on outcome)

per_100_claims.realistic_model_calls_saved_per_100: about 0.26 reviewer calls (1 review per review final); deterministic compute increase negligible
per_100_claims.cost_implication: Negligible at this corpus size and sample; no economic case for Tier-2 on review finals alone.

canaries.ENT_C: Permanent negative control preserved: no Tier-2 mapping solves ENT-C; invalid auto-CONTRADICTED stays forbidden.
canaries.N_A4_N_R1: Adversarial controls preserved: no proposed Tier-2 re-imports referral/actor-membership overreach; CAL031 and N-C3 flagged as same-family hazards requiring role-hierarchy preconditions.
canaries.ACT_25: Positive canary: explicit proof, correct target, zero hidden premise; CAL015 is the only case matching this standard.

threshold_check.threshold_definition: Tier-2 is not worth prototyping if realistic expectation is only 1-2 extra auto decisions in the 389-row development corpus or <2pp review-rate reduction, unless the operator is extremely simple and low-risk.
threshold_check.verdict: Fails threshold. The single qualifying operator is simple and low-risk but its payoff is one case in this corpus.
